display_name: Rayfield Contractor Site — Bullard & Sequoia (Rancho Coronado)
why: A fenced roadworks/construction site in Rancho Coronado where a Rayfield engineer is updating Yorinobu Arasaka's Caliburn "Mordred" out of sight. In vanilla the whole population is quest-spawned by Freedom (mq059); this proposal loads the quest's people layer, switches the site to its working variant (foreman's workbench, laptop, tablet, spotlights and site security system) and activates the site community: six private-security guards, the engineer and two parked sedans. The dam crash pile, the Mordred car and the NPD response stay off, so the venue reads as a guarded contractor site in normal business, not as the job's aftermath.

open_questions: Check the six private security on post: they should stand, smoke or patrol calmly around the workbench, never crouch into cover or aim, and the two Emperor sedans should sit level in the lot.
Check the engineer at the workbench: she should stand at the tablet working at about (524.3,-1402.7,20.3), not float where the table should be.

Check the site's restricted area: walk into the fenced work zone and see whether the guards treat V as a trespasser and open fire; if they attack on sight, decide whether that is the intended guarded-site behaviour or whether the security area needs a venue exception.

Check the anchor: the venue proximity breadcrumb should flip at the workbench laptop (#mq059_laptop); if it never does, the mq059_variant_loc_2 toggle or the laptop entity did not stream and only the boot activation ran.
Check the site dressing: scaffolding, crates, broken blockade and the lit workbench should be present, with no wrecked cars, corpses, tyre tracks or Rayfield Caliburn anywhere.
Check the dam end of the venue: the crash corner should stay bare road with no 6th Street group or wreck props.

communities.why: The whole site detail in its only phase loc_2, exactly as vanilla mq059_loc2 switches it on: loc2_merc_1..6 (private security), loc2_rayflied_engineer (the Rayfield engineer) and the two Emperor sedans. The resolved spots are idle posts, not a combat line: merc_1 smokes, merc_2 stands guard, four are plain standing markers, and the engineer works a tablet at the foreman's table. That is the staffed contractor site the wiki describes ("heavily guarded by private security") without the job's fight.

variant_toggles.why: The working-site look. mq059_variant_loc_2 is the site's own dressing (the foreman's workbench with #mq059_laptop, #mq059_tablet and monitors, the work lights, and the #mq059_security_area/system the staffed site uses); with it off the engineer works at a table that does not exist and the only usable proximity anchor is gone. loc_1 (dam crash wreck, corpses, tyre tracks), loc_3 (Mordred chase) and key (the skeleton-key pickup) stay off, and crowd_remover stays 0 so the surrounding crowd is not stripped. setup asserts exactly the all-zero base, loc2 raises loc_2, cleanup raises crowd_remover.

proximity_wait.why: The site laptop on the foreman's workbench at about (522.6,-1401.5,20.9), one to eight metres from the engineer and the guards' posts, and the only device vanilla drives at this venue with a resolved world path. It streams with mq059_variant_loc_2, which this proposal pins on, so the boot and post-proximity activations both land at the spot where the people are.
